The Chaos Years.text: The chaos years are the first decades after Quirks appeared, when no law, job or institution was built for people with powers and much of the world came apart. Quirk crime outran the police: robberies no lock could stop, gangs built around a few strong Quirks, towns where the strongest person nearby made the rules. Fear ran the other way too: mobs attacked people with frightening bodies, early heteromorphs were driven from homes and jobs, and courts could not say whether a Quirk was a weapon. Militant movements, the Meta Liberation Army the best remembered, fought the government over the right to use powers freely. Textbooks present the period as a warning, and its memory is why most people accept strict Quirk laws without complaint.
